cards.kiln: a round clay kiln with a glowing arched door and a short chimney, front three-quarter view, one single object, centred, whole object visible, matte painted look matching the game's other models, game-ready proportions, plain light-grey (#d9d9d9) background, even soft studio light, no cast shadow, 1024x1024. No text, letters or numbers.

style: Hand-painted gouache illustration for a glazed-tile mosaic workshop game, jewel-bright glaze colours, warm kiln glow, matte paper texture, slightly wobbly dark ink outline, simple readable silhouette, no text
notes: Source paintings for the image-to-3D step. Save each as <name>.png (1024x1024), run image-to-3D, export the FULL-DETAIL glb as the target path (games/<slug>/models/<item>.glb); the lite copy is made by us. Light-grey background on purpose: the 3D step removes it and a green background would tint the model colours. Keys are <slug>--<item>. Where "ref" is set, an existing painting of the same thing is in the repo: use it as the image-to-image reference for the same look.

kiln.why: the factory display is a flat disc
